name: Gal Oya National Park
description: Gal Oya National Park, nestled in the Eastern Province, offers a serene retreat where nature lovers can explore lush forests, crystal-clear streams, and the majestic Senanayake Samudra Reservoir. This protected area provides a perfect escape from the hustle of daily life.
mobile_signal: Weak inside park; moderate near Inginiyagala
activities: Boat safaris, jungle treks, bird watching
wheelchair_access: limited - boat safari and jeep-based tours
monsoon_note: Senanayake Samudra reservoir levels rise during NE monsoon (Oct-Jan), improving boat safari views; some tracks muddy

name: Kumana National Park
description: Kumana National Park, a sanctuary of nature and wildlife, offers breathtaking landscapes and a rich ecosystem teeming with birds and aquatic life. Located in Ampara district, it's a haven for birdwatchers and nature enthusiasts, perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape from the hustle of everyday life.
food_nearby: very limited - nearest options in arugam bay/pottuvil

name: Maduru Oya National Park
description: Maduru Oya National Park is a serene sanctuary nestled in the Eastern Province, known for its lush landscapes, diverse wildlife, and ancient ruins. This protected area offers visitors a chance to explore nature while learning about the region's rich cultural heritage.
activities: Bird watching, jungle trekking, cultural tours

name: Lahugala Kitulana National Park
description: Lahugala Kitulana National Park, a lush sanctuary nestled in the Eastern Province, offers visitors a chance to explore its diverse wildlife and natural beauty. Home to elephants, leopards, and various bird species, it’s a haven for nature lovers and photographers alike.
ticket_price: LKR 40 + LKR 300 group fee (local); USD 10 + USD 8 group fee (foreign) + 15% VAT
food_nearby: limited - shops in nearby pottuvil/lahugala town

name: Ampara Paddy Farm
description: Ampara Paddy Farm stands as a testament to Eastern Province's rich agricultural heritage. Nestled amidst lush paddy fields, this estate offers a serene backdrop where visitors can learn about traditional farming practices and witness the vibrant culture of tea cultivation.
activities: Tea plantation tour, cultural experience, local food tasting

name: Lahugala Organic Garden
description: Discover the lush Lahugala Organic Garden, nestled in the Ampara district. This serene estate offers a glimpse into traditional tea cultivation practices, surrounded by vibrant greenery and tranquil ponds. Experience the harmonious blend of nature and craftsmanship here.
activities: Tea plantation tour, Bird watching, Picnic
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; best season Apr–Sep

name: Deegawapi Herb Walk
description: Deegawapi Herb Walk is a serene tea estate in Ampara District, Eastern Province, known for its lush greenery, traditional tea plantations, and historical significance. Visitors can explore the beautiful gardens, learn about tea cultivation, and enjoy the tranquil atmosphere.
activities: Explore tea plantations, Learn about tea cultivation, Relax in the gardens

name: Uhana Spice Farm
description: Discover Uhana Spice Farm, a serene tea estate nestled amidst lush greenery and vibrant flora. Here, you can witness the traditional Sri Lankan tea-making process, learn about the local culture, and enjoy breathtaking views of the Eastern Province’s natural beauty.
activities: Tea plantation tour, Cultural workshops, Picnic spot

name: Kalmunai Coconut Estate
description: Kalmunai Coconut Estate stands as a testament to traditional Sri Lankan tea cultivation, nestled amidst lush coconut groves. This estate offers a glimpse into the rich cultural heritage and agricultural practices of the Eastern Province, with its carefully tended tea plants and abundant coconuts.
activities: Explore the tea plantation trails, Learn about traditional farming methods, Visit the nearby coconut groves
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; best season Apr–Sep

name: Sammanthurai Garden
description: Sammanthurai Garden, nestled amidst lush tea plantations, offers visitors a serene escape with its tranquil ponds, ancient temples, and breathtaking views of the Eastern Province’s natural beauty. This estate is not just a place to visit but a journey through time and culture.
activities: Tea plantation tour, Historical temple visit, Picnic at scenic spots

name: Akkaraipattu Farm
description: Akkaraipattu Farm, nestled amidst lush tea plantations, offers visitors a serene retreat where one can immerse themselves in the tranquil beauty of Eastern Province's natural landscapes. This historic estate, known for its rich cultural heritage and picturesque views, attracts nature lovers and tea enthusiasts alike.
activities: Tea plantation tour, Cultural heritage walk, Bird watching
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; best season Apr–Sep

name: Nintavur Garden
description: Nintavur Garden, nestled in the lush Eastern Province, is a serene tea estate where visitors can savor the rich aroma of freshly brewed tea while exploring its tranquil gardens and learning about the local culture and history.
activities: Explore the tea plantation, Visit the local tea museum, Enjoy tea tasting
monsoon_note: Oct–Jan NE monsoon; best season Apr–Sep

name: Karaitivu Coconut Walk
description: Karaitivu Coconut Walk is a serene tea estate where lush coconut groves and traditional Sri Lankan architecture blend harmoniously, offering visitors a glimpse into the island’s rich cultural heritage and natural beauty.
activities: Explore the tea plantation trails, Visit the local tea museum, Enjoy a leisurely walk along the coconut groves

name: Ampara Valley Tea
description: Ampara Valley Tea is a serene tea estate nestled in the lush green hills of Ampara District, Eastern Province. Known for its pristine landscapes and traditional tea-making practices, it offers visitors a glimpse into the rich cultural heritage of Sri Lanka.
activities: Explore tea plantation trails, Learn about tea making process, Visit local tea museum
